'''Gold Six''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of the second member of Gold Squadron. There were a number of starfighter squadrons with this name, and multiple [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] went by the call sign Gold Six.

==History==
[[Gold Six (clone trooper)/Legends|"Gold Six"]], a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]], flew a [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighter]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Gold Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] during the [[Battle of Bothawui/Legends|Battle of Bothawui]] in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="DoD" />

Gold Six was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Hol Okand/Legends|Hol Okand]] when he flew with [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="CCG" /> where he and the rest of the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]]&mdash;save [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]]&mdash;were killed in the assault against the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]].<ref name="XWOSG">''[[X-Wing: The Official Strategy Guide]]''</ref>
